id: title:dmarchuk:reject wait conditions that only a re check could satisfy

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the implementation of clock-dependent wait condition removal and polling dependency cleanup, specifically the checks and helper functions required to identify and strip clock-dependent waits before polling removal.
review.reason: Adds dependencies and helper functions to detect and remove clock-dependent wait conditions, which is a prerequisite for removing polling and 10-minute re-check workflows. This represents a substantive, bounded implementation step rather than a complete systemic change.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the actual polling removal or the workflow removing the 10-minute re-check, so the full benefit and systemic impact are not demonstrated; this score reflects only the observed implementation support.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the polling removal or the workflow that removes the 10-minute re-check, nor does it show the removal of the polling dependency. It only shows the rejection of clock-dependent waits at save time and the preservation of existing clock-dependent waits.
